mapper.update: UPDATE outbox_event SET lock_owner=#{owner},locked_until=#{until} WHERE event_id=#{id} AND published_at IS NULL AND (next_attempt_at IS NULL OR next_attempt_at <= #{now}) AND (locked_until IS NULL OR locked_until < #{now})
UPDATE outbox_event SET published_at=#{now},last_error=NULL,lock_owner=NULL,locked_until=NULL WHERE event_id=#{id} AND lock_owner=#{owner}
UPDATE outbox_event SET attempts=attempts+1,last_error=#{error},next_attempt_at=#{next},lock_owner=NULL,locked_until=NULL WHERE event_id=#{id} AND lock_owner=#{owner}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM outbox_event WHERE published_at IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM outbox_event WHERE published_at IS NULL AND attempts>0
SELECT COALESCE(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,MIN(created_at),CURRENT_TIMESTAMP),0) FROM outbox_event WHERE published_at IS NULL
